tools.name: list_destination_plans
tools.description: Lists the eSIM plans that Horizon sells now for one destination (a country or a region): the data amount, the number of days, the unlimited flag, the price in EUR and a link to each plan's page on horizonesim.com. Takes the destination's English name or slug, for example "Netherlands", "United State

tools.name: get_destination_coverage
tools.description: Shows the countries and published local mobile networks for a Horizon destination, with currently verified 4G/5G claims. Use for regional coverage, a stopover, or manual network selection. Country inclusion does not guarantee signal everywhere, and an absent radio claim does not prove a network lack

tools.name: check_device_compatibility
tools.description: Looks up a phone or cellular tablet in Horizon's curated eSIM device list. A listed model is not proof that every regional variant is compatible or carrier-unlocked, and not_listed does not mean incompatible. tools.name: get_troubleshooting_steps
tools.description: Returns Horizon's approved steps for one eSIM problem, in the customer's language and in the order to try them: the eSIM does not install, no signal, signal but no internet, slow data, or the hotspot does not work. None of the steps deletes the eSIM.

tools.name: get_support_policy
tools.description: Answers activation and first-use timing, refund eligibility, hotspot and speed policy, or human support availability from Horizon's shared policy constants. No order ID or verification is needed. This never performs a refund or a handoff.
